items.html: And behold, now they are back to back, but she still has only Nefesh and Ruach, for she is still from the Chazeh downward, where the aspect of Ruach is. For up to the Chazeh stands the Yesod of Bina, called Neshama, as is known. Also, since she does not take from Bina herself, but from ZA himself, called Ruach; and also since he is below the Chazeh, as above, where ZA himself has only Ruach, therefore only her Ruach reached her, for her Neshama was given to the Malchut of ZA himself, as above.
